description: Owns representative performance baselines, bottleneck classification, benchmark interpretation, and evidence-based optimization decisions.
user_intent_examples: Measure this slow Python path and compare one optimization safely.
when_to_load: When runtime, latency, throughput, memory, I/O, profiling, or benchmark evidence is a primary requirement.
when_not_to_load: Do not load when no named performance objective or suspected material bottleneck exists.
do_not_regress: Do not restore arbitrary percentage or Pareto thresholds.
Do not disable garbage collection or prescribe weak references without evidence.
Do not claim speedups without representative repeated measurements.
Do not force companion prompts or startup loading.
